def turan_edges(m, k):
    r = m // k
    rem = m % k
    # rem parts of size r+1, k-rem parts of size r
    # total edges = binom(m, 2) - sum(binom(size, 2))
    def binom2(n):
        return n * (n - 1) // 2
    
    total_edges = binom2(m)
    sum_binom_r = rem * binom2(r + 1) + (k - rem) * binom2(r)
    return total_edges - sum_binom_r

print(turan_edges(1000, 143))
